articles.title: ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Attracts Over 2,900 Participants Across Five Days
articles.rawDate: Oct.15 ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Attracts Over 2,900 Participants Across Five Days
articles.summary: Macao, Oct. 15, 2026 – The five-day NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026, organised by Sands China and NBA Cares, wrapped up after attracting more than 2,900 participants from Oct. 7–11. NBA legends, GBA students and teachers, and Macao community groups took part in basketball-anchored activities promoting youth development and social inclusion.

articles.title: Argo at Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong Celebrates Its Highest-Ever Ranking at No. 25 in the World’s 50 Best Bars 2026
articles.summary: ARGO at Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong has been ranked No. 25 in The World’s 50 Best Bars 2026, marking its highest-ever position on the prestigious global list. ARGO is one of only four bars in Hong Kong recognized in the top 50 and the only hotel bar in the city to receive this honour.

articles.title: Five Wynn Restaurants Recognized in the 2027 LA LISTE The World's Best Restaurant Selection
articles.summary: Macao, October 12, 2026 – Five Wynn restaurants were included in the 2027 LA LISTE The World's Best Restaurant Selection: Chef Tam's Seasons, Lakeview Palace, Mizumi and SW Steakhouse at Wynn Palace, and Wing Lei at Wynn Macau. They were recognised at the Greater China Region Awards Ceremony in Changzhou, China.

articles.title: MGM’s Two Restaurants Again Named Among La Liste’s Top 1000 World’s Best Restaurants 2027
articles.summary: October 12, 2026, Macau – MGM’s Imperial Court and Five Foot Road were again named among La Liste’s Top 1,000 World’s Best Restaurants 2027, their second consecutive year on the list. The restaurants specialise in Lingnan and Chengdu-style Sichuan cuisine respectively.

articles.title: Wynn Supports Welfare Shop Project of Macau Holy House of Mercy for 14th Consecutive Year
articles.summary: Macao, October 10, 2026 – Wynn continued its 14th consecutive year of support for the Welfare Shop Project of Macau Holy House of Mercy (SCMM), donating MOP300,000 and sponsoring food hampers for 371 underprivileged families. Around 40 Wynn volunteers helped distribute rice, noodles, canned food, edible oil and other daily necessities at the SCMM Welfare Shop.

articles.title: ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Successfully Concludes
articles.rawDate: Oct.11 ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Successfully Concludes
articles.summary: Macao, Oct. 11, 2026 – Sands China and NBA Cares closed Community Impact Week 2026 with a Community Basketball Carnival at NBA HOUSE at The Venetian Macao. NBA legend Chris Bosh, Sir David Beckham and around 200 participants, including Macau Special Olympics members, joined the concluding event.

articles.title: Sands China Joins Hands with NBA Legend to Distribute Boxed Lunches to the Macao Community
articles.rawDate: Oct.10 Sands China Joins Hands with NBA Legend to Distribute Boxed Lunches to the Macao Community
articles.summary: Macao, Oct. 10, 2026 – On Health and Wellness Day of Community Impact Week, Sands China and NBA Cares joined NBA legends Stephon Marbury and Cuttino Mobley at Fuhong Society of Macau’s Happy Kitchen to assemble and distribute boxed lunches that will benefit 1,500 people. A plaque unveiling marked the official launch of the social enterprise’s new service.

articles.title: ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Celebrates Tip-Off
articles.rawDate: Oct.8 ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Celebrates Tip-Off
articles.summary: Macao, Oct. 8, 2026 – Sands China and NBA Cares held Tip-Off Day of Community Impact Week at The Venetian Arena with around 400 participants, including Dallas Mavericks and Houston Rockets players, NBA legends and Macao school basketball teams. Players mentored local championship teams and led a basketball clinic on the NBA court.

articles.title: SJM Hosts National Day Reception with Over 2,000 Team Members to Celebrate the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People’s Republic of China
articles.summary: Macau, 8 October 2026 – SJM hosted a National Day reception at Grand Lisboa Palace Resort Macau with over 2,000 team members to mark the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China. The event opened with a flag-raising ceremony and remarks from Managing Director Daisy Ho and SWCC Chairman Angela Leong.

articles.title: Wynn Officially Unveils the Highly Acclaimed 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards in November
articles.summary: Macao, October 8, 2026 — “Wynn Signature” will unveil the full-year calendar for the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards on November 9, 2026, with entries opening March 1, 2027. In a first for the awards, Beijing will host Judging Week from August 21 to 25, 2027, and the Awards Ceremony will be held in Macao on October 29, 2027.

articles.title: Sands China Launches ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’
articles.rawDate: Oct.7 Sands China Launches ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’
articles.summary: Macao, Oct. 7, 2026 – Sands China launched the five-day NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026 (Oct. 7–11) with Youth Day at the Macao East Asian Games Dome. The opening event brought together 150 young players from eight Macao schools and 50 from Hong Kong and mainland GBA cities for training led by NBA legend Ray Allen.
